title: shared-attribute-graph-audit: reproducibility artifact for 'Where Do the Gains Come From? Auditing Shared-Attribute Heterogeneous Graphs for Encrypted Traffic Intrusion Detection'

creators.name: Jeong, Sooyong
creators.affiliation: Korea Institute of Science and Technology Information (KISTI)

description: Scripts, configuration, graph-construction records, and per-seed results that reproduce every table in the paper: pre-training relation profiling, split audits, five edge-only controls, the three-component decomposition of graph gains, repeated-split variants, and the inductive deployment evaluation on five public encrypted-traffic benchmarks. Raw datasets are not redistributed; see README for extraction.
